title: AgentToolContract
description: Standard envelope shape for all Copilot Studio tool flow inputs and outputs. Locked per Topic 8C. Used by cch_AgentToolWrapper and every tool flow under solutions/ContinuumHealthDemo/src/Workflows/. Validated by the Tier-1 schema-drift job (Phase 4+).

ErrorCode.description: 10-code error enum for tool flow failures.

Citation.description: A source citation returned by a knowledge-grounded tool flow.

title.description: Human-readable citation title (document name, article heading, etc.).

url.description: Permalink to the source document or SharePoint file.

excerpt.description: Short verbatim excerpt that supports the claim (max 500 chars).

ToolInput.description: Minimal required input fields shared by all tool flows.

correlationId.description: Correlation ID propagated from the parent agent conversation. Used by cch_AgentToolWrapper for telemetry.

ToolOutput.description: Standard response envelope returned by every tool flow. cch_AgentToolWrapper validates that child flows conform to this shape.

success.description: True if the tool call completed successfully; false otherwise.

data.description: Tool-specific result payload. Shape varies per tool flow; see individual flow definitions.

displayMessage.description: Human-readable summary suitable for the agent to surface to the user. Must be non-empty when success=true. Required when success=false.

citations.description: Optional list of source citations supporting the response.

correlationId.description: Echo of the input correlationId, enabling the agent to correlate logs.

errorCode.description: Required when success=false. Omitted when success=true.

LogStartPayload.description: Payload passed to cch_AgentToolWrapper operation=LogStart at the start of every tool flow.

toolName.description: Logical name of the tool flow (e.g. RequestReplacement, FileComplaint).

argsJson.description: JSON-serialised (pre-redacted) input arguments. Redaction applied by cch_LogTelemetry.

LogFinishPayload.description: Payload passed to cch_AgentToolWrapper operation=LogFinish at the end of every tool flow.

toolName.description: Logical name of the tool flow.

success.description: Whether the tool flow completed successfully.

durationMs.description: Elapsed time in milliseconds from LogStart to LogFinish.
